desc:
🎃 UPDATE 5, HALLOWEEN!!! 
-Pumpkin Race, 12 new characters (5 which are golden)!
-Halloween Mode, with many new bots and materials!
-Challenges, one new limited time challenge has been added to the Mission Hub...
-The Halloween event will end on update 6, so get the new characters while you can!

🤖 A massive army of bots have invaded Roblox! 
⚔️ Fortunately, the Gear Alliance have come to stop them!

-Play as a soldier from one of multiple gear races and fight against waves of bots!
-Level up your race and unlock more powerful characters!
-Open lucky blocks and equip artifacts to boost your strength!
-Control the mighty colossi and annihilate the bot army!

Playing in private servers is highly recommended.

This game is new and will have lots of bugs, and possibly some balancing issues.
I am currently working on addressing as many of those as possible.

Inspired by Skibidi Toilet.
